description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class 'AbstractHttpRequestActor' for handling HTTP requests within an Akka framework. It manages request processing, response rendering, error handling, headers translation, and acknowledgment aggregation. The class facilitates customizable behavior for HTTP request handling in a service gateway context, including timeouts, response modification, and specific message handling.

classes.name: AbstractHttpRequestActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class designed to handle and process HTTP requests within a service gateway, managing responses, errors, headers, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Constructs the actor's behavior, handling failure, special messages like Whoami, command processing, timeout, and unknown messages.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Processes incoming Command messages, sets up acknowledgment aggregation, and determines response behavior.

methods.name: onAggregatedResponseOrError
methods.description: Callback invoked upon acknowledgment aggregation completion, forwarding response or error.

methods.name: handleCommandWithAckregator
methods.description: Sends command to proxy actor with an acknowledgment aggregator.

methods.name: handleCommandWithoutAckregator
methods.description: Handles commands directly without acknowledgment aggregation.

methods.name: completeAcknowledgements
methods.description: Completes the HTTP response with acknowledgment results.

methods.name: handleCommandAndAcceptImmediately
methods.description: Handles commands that do not expect a response by immediately replying with HTTP 202.

methods.name: getTimeoutExceptionSupplier
methods.description: Provides a supplier for timeout exceptions based on command.

methods.name: rememberResponseLocationUri
methods.description: Stores URI if the command response indicates resource creation.

methods.name: getExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts internal headers to external representation for HTTP response.

methods.name: handleWhoami
methods.description: Processes Whoami requests to generate user info response.

methods.name: createWhoamiResponse
methods.description: Constructs a WhoamiResponse based on the request, overriding in subclasses for customization.

methods.name: getAuthContextWithPrefixedSubjectsFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts authorization context from headers, with support for specific subject prefixes.

methods.name: handleCommandWithResponse
methods.description: Sends commands and sets up actor state for awaiting responses or timeouts.

methods.name: handleMessageResponseMessage
methods.description: Transforms message responses into HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles receive timeout events, generating appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Processes exceptions to generate proper HTTP error responses.

methods.name: buildResponseWithoutHeadersFromDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Creates an HTTP response for a given exception, possibly without headers.

methods.name: enhanceResponseWithExternalDittoHeaders
methods.description: Augments responses with external headers derived from internal headers.

methods.name: completeWithResult
methods.description: Completes the response future and stops the actor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the actor gracefully.

methods.name: addEntityAccordingToContentType
methods.description: Adds an entity to the response based on content type and payload.

methods.name: createBodyAddingResponseMapper
methods.description: Creates a mapper to add body content based on entity presence and schema.

methods.name: createHttpResponseWithHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Builds an HTTP response with headers and optional body.

methods.name: modifyResponse
methods.description: Modifies response, e.g., adding Location header upon resource creation.

methods.name: getUriForLocationHeader
methods.description: Provides URI for Location header based on command response.

methods.name: mapAcknowledgementsForHttp
methods.description: Transforms acknowledgment data into HTTP-compatible form.

methods.name: isResponseRequired
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP response is needed based on command headers.

methods.name: setResponseLocationForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Sets location URI in acknowledgment if applicable.
